_comment: Hard-coded texts of other mods made translatable (TextPatcher). When one of the classes loads and the group's mod is installed, each text below that the class uses (as a constant, or built with values: %s) is replaced by the translation of 'vanilla-finest-fixes.<group>.<name>', falling back to the mod's own text. 'methods': only methods whose name contains this (for code another mod's mixin put into a Minecraft class). 'literal': also texts made at run time that go into Component.literal. 'arrays': also the texts in text arrays read from static fields (filled before the languages load). 'calls': also the text results of these methods (owner/Class.name), for a setting the pack fills with a text. The English is in assets/vanilla-finest-fixes/lang/en_us.json; the classes are also listed in mixin.texts.HardcodedTextsMixin.
